title: PracticePay Late Fee: Principal-Left Bands
content:
**Rule.** The principal share of a PracticePay Patient Financing late fee reads the principal left on the plan's ledger, which is the financed charge plus returned payments less payments and provider refunds: principal left below 1000.00 USD gives 0.8, at least 1000.00 USD and below 3000.00 USD gives 0.9, and 3000.00 USD or more gives 1.

| Principal left on the plan's ledger | Principal share |
|---|---|
| below 1000.00 | 0.8 |
| 1000.00 or more, below 3000.00 | 0.9 |
| 3000.00 or more | 1 |

The principal left counts only the financed charge, returned payments, payments and provider refunds; fees and interest do not enter it.

*Hypothetical.* Financed charge 1500.00, payments 700.00, no returns or refunds: principal left 800.00, share 0.8. With one of those payments, of 200.00, returned: 1000.00, share 0.9.
